dogecoin.text: @elonmusk The day you withdraw your support, this bubble will burst and people will regret the money they invested. Because most people who invest in Dogecoin enter the crypto market according to your words without doing research.

@elonmusk You recommend a coin without a project to everyone. What you are doing is nothing more than manipulating the market. By inflating the Dogecoin bubble, you ensure that the volume is transferred from other coins to an unqualified coin.
